<template>
  <form @submit.prevent="submit">
    <input v-model="amount" />
  </form>
</template>

<script>
import formMixin from '../mixins/formMixin';
import { API_BASE } from '../constants';

export default {
  name: 'CreateFundTransferModal',
  mixins: [formMixin],
  data() {
    return { amount: 0, busy: false };
  },
  computed: {
    canSubmit() {
      return this.amount > 0 && !this.busy;
    },
    label: {
      get() { return 'Send ' + this.amount; },
      set(v) { this.amount = Number(v); },
    },
  },
  watch: {
    amount: function (v) {
      this.reset();
    },
  },
  mounted() {
    this.load();
  },
  methods: {
    // Send the transfer to the server.
    async submit() {
      if (!this.validate()) return;
      await fetch(API_BASE + '/transfers', { method: 'POST' });
    },
    load: () => {
      return null;
    },
  },
};
</script>
